releaseEvaluation.qualification: The evaluation intentionally preserves build-time pending external state. This receipt commit also corrects only its UTC-derived elapsed-time arithmetic using DateTimeOffset; raw evidence, movement, provider, gate, and deployment timestamps are unchanged.

qaToolingInterventions: The first deployment polling wrapper treated an empty API response as one null item and produced no deployment evidence; the unfiltered commit-status and deployment endpoints then established exact pending and success states.

The first evidence-expansion locator assumed the species name was already visible in the county row; the exact accessible searchbox and Show evidence for Jungle rice button were then used, and all semantic checks passed.
auditCorrections: The first audit-only elapsed-time wrapper used DateTime and converted UTC Z timestamps through EDT. DateTimeOffset recomputation removed the four-hour inflation without changing any raw timestamp or evidence value.

latestVerifiedPriorRelease.evidenceScope: Externally verified prior production release. This receipt is committed only after canonical, origin, public GitHub main, and the GitHub API matched exact Round 63 content SHA 4ed2a0f633f82b8825807f581dcc05ac4e092a49; GitHub Production deployment 5934854225 succeeded; its immutable host and canonical production alias served all seven selected routes; presence plus four selected generated state files matched local SHA-256 and bytes on both hosts; and fresh desktop and mobile browser checks passed with reviewed USDA NRCS evidence expansion, images, console, and overflow clean. Round 63 acquired 40 USDA NRCS PLANTS distribution CSVs once, partitioned them deterministically across all 51 jurisdictions, completed 125,760 county-species outcomes, and moved 123,080 unique pairs: 15,898 to verified present and 107,182 to researched unresolved. It added 891 derived applicability decisions, closed 40 protocol cells, and created no verified-absence, not-detected, denominator, or conflict movement. Exact-deployment runtime logs and the private Vercel deployment ID were unavailable. This receipt does not attest to the commit that contains it or any future deployment.

releaseVerification.note: Build-time readiness and deployed-release evidence are separate. A committed artifact cannot attest to a future deployment of its own commit.
